sidebar.title: Diary
skin.heading: Skin
editor.commitTooltip: Push the current draft to GitHub (Ctrl+Enter)
editor.emptyHint: Select a date from the sidebar or click "+ Today" to start writing.
editor.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this diary entry?
gallery.title: Image gallery
gallery.empty: No images yet. Add one from the editor with 🖼️ or by pasting.
gallery.deleteConfirm: Delete this image from your repository? Any diary entry that references it will show a broken image. This can't be undone.
gallery.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete the image. Please try again.
gallery.loadError: Couldn't load images. Check your connection and try again.
setup.subtitleWelcome: Welcome! Let's set up your diary.
setup.subtitleUpdate: Set up the private GitHub repo that stores your diary.
setup.tokenHint: Requires repository Contents permission (Read and Write). Your token is stored only in your browser, never uploaded.
setup.disconnectHint: Clears the repository settings and cached drafts from this browser. Your entries in the repo are not affected.
setup.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect and erase local data? Your token and repo settings will be removed from this browser, and any drafts not yet committed to GitHub will be discarded. Entries already committed stay safe in your repository.
setup.footer: Your token is stored only in your browser. Never uploaded.
setup.errorNoWrite: Token does not have write access. Please make sure your Fine-Grained PAT has 'Contents: Read and Write' permission.
setup.errorInvalidOwner: Owner must be a valid GitHub username or organization (1-39 letters, digits, or hyphens).
setup.errorInvalidRepo: Repository name must be 1-100 characters using letters, digits, dots, underscores, or hyphens.
setup.errorInvalidToken: Token doesn't look like a GitHub PAT. Expected 'github_pat_…' or 'ghp_…'.
status.pending: Draft saved locally — not committed   (Ctrl+Enter to commit)
loadError.authBody: Your GitHub token was rejected (it may be invalid, expired, or missing Contents access). Reconnect with a valid token to continue.
loadError.genericBody: GitDiary couldn't reach your repository. Check your connection and repo settings, then try again.
home.resizerTooltip: Drag to resize · double-click to reset
lock.title: GitDiary is locked
lock.subtitle: Enter your password to unlock this diary.
lock.hint: Your password decrypts the token stored in this browser. It is never uploaded, and there is no way to recover it — if you forget it, you'll re-enter your GitHub token.
setup.lockPlaceholder: Set a password to lock the app
setup.lockHint: Encrypts your token (and cached drafts) in this browser so the app asks for a password before opening. There is no recovery — forget it and you'll re-enter your token.
setup.lockChangeHint: Changing re-encrypts everything with the new password. Removing stores your token unencrypted again.
setup.lockRemoved: ✅ Password removed — the app will no longer lock.
setup.lockError: ❌ Something went wrong. Please try again.
setup.errorPwTooShort: Password must be at least {0} characters.
